name: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Ltd
title: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Ltd-$ - 520111 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Standalone Q4 sales fell to INR893 cr from INR1,575 cr on muted orders and Middle East shipping disruption; management guides FY27 standalone INR4,800-5,000 cr assuming normalisation within a month.

utilisation.quote: stand-alone performance remained impacted by subdued demand conditions impacting order inflows and resulted in lower capacity utilization

capex.peers_comment: Management said stainless-steel capacity additions by others are mostly pierced seamless, which Ratnamani does not cater to; only one new extruded player expected.
capex.quote: most of the capacity is for the pierced seamless products. So which market as it is, Ratnamani is not catering to.

triggers.label: Stainless prices down, volume up
triggers.quote: the stainless-steel volume in the last fiscal year actually went up, not down, but the prices were down

triggers.label: Standalone Q4 sales down 43% YoY
triggers.quote: our sales for Q4 stood at INR893 crores as against the base of INR1,575 crores in Q4 of the previous year
triggers.highlight: INR893 crores as against the base of INR1,575 crores

triggers.label: FY27 standalone INR4,800-5,000 cr
triggers.quote: Our budget for the year, say, is close to anywhere -- on a stand-alone basis, anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores.
triggers.highlight: anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores

triggers.label: RTL FY27 growth cut to 10-15%
triggers.quote: So same, RTL this year, we can consider a growth of 10% to 15%
triggers.highlight: we can consider a growth of 10% to 15%

triggers.label: Piercing gaining acceptance in power
triggers.quote: substantial capacities have been added in stainless-steel seamless segment. Products are being accepted.

guidance.quote: anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores
Margins say, 16% plus/minus 1%, definitely, it can be maintained.
So same, RTL this year, we can consider a growth of 10% to 15%
For spool business, we can see a growth of 20%. 20%, 25% for this particular year.
going forward, I think the margins should be in the range of 20% to 25%.
the routine capex items, I think INR150 crores to INR200 crores.

prior_guidance_check.quote: So, we are toning down our guidance fro m 15% to 20% to 10% to 15% in '27, correct?
there was no negative impact on the EBITDA margins in percentage terms, both for the quarter and for the year

red_flags.quote: the Board has decided to recommend a lower dividend of INR10 per share

red_flags.label: Management says FY27 target assumes normalisation in a month
red_flags.quote: It's assuming that everything will be back to normal in a month's time.

red_flags.label: Standalone order book flat-to-down, export and SS down
red_flags.quote: our stainless-steel order book is down and our export order book is also down

evasions.quote: Since it is -- all the capex put together is not significant, it is not -- or it is part of our routine capex. So, it is not highlighted separately.

evasions.quote: No. See, we would not have that data in detail, but our customers would definitely, yes.
